tldr: Evening batch, Aug 10: Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer — a 30B Apache-2.0 multimodal model purpose-built for always-on local agent workflows — while OpenAI acquires NextSlide to bring AI-generated presentations into ChatGPT. Hermes Agent processed 1.5T tokens on OpenRouter in early August (33.1T all-time), nearly matching all other tracked apps combined, and Docker ships disposable sandboxes for AI agents. Claude Code makes auto mode the default Aug 14 with classifier overhead no longer charged; Zo adds 2K video generation, an MCP server and a Skills tab; Hugging Face research shows how to make knowledge distillation cheap enough to run at scale.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Muse Glimmer: 30B Model for Local Agent Workflows
articles.summary: Meta releases Muse Glimmer, a 30B dense multimodal open-weight model (Apache 2.0) tuned for always-on local agent workflows; Muse Spark 1.2 coming soon.

articles.title: OpenAI Acquires NextSlide to Bring AI-Generated Presentations Into ChatGPT
articles.summary: OpenAI buys NextSlide, the prompt-to-presentation startup, to bring AI-generated slides into ChatGPT.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Processed 1.5 Trillion Tokens on OpenRouter in Early August
articles.summary: Hermes Agent's early-August OpenRouter volume nearly matches all 49 other tracked apps combined; 33.1T tokens all-time across 407 models since March.

articles.title: Docker Launches Disposable, Isolated Sandboxes for AI Agents
articles.summary: Docker ships purpose-built ephemeral sandboxes for AI agents — disposable, isolated compute for tool execution, evals and untrusted code.

articles.title: Making Knowledge Distillation Cheap Enough to Run at Scale
articles.summary: Multiverse Computing on HF: a practical recipe for running knowledge distillation at scale without breaking the compute budget.

articles.title: Claude Code Auto Mode Becomes the Default
articles.summary: Auto mode becomes the default for Pro/Max/Team on Aug 14; classifier overhead no longer charged — caught 89% of harmful actions in testing vs 13.6% human review.

articles.title: Zo Update: 2K Video Generation, MCP Server, Skills Tab, Sonnet 4.6
articles.summary: Zo's week-of-Aug-3 changelog: MiniMax H3 2K video with synchronized audio, an MCP server for external clients, a Skills tab, and Sonnet 4.6 intro pricing through Aug 31.
